name: audit_site
description: Audits every page linked from an index page: status, trimmed title, h1 count (ignoring HTML comments), sorted distinct broken link hrefs. Writes the JSON to outPath and returns a summary.
whenToUse: When asked to (re-)audit the small website and write audit.json.

outPath.description: Output path relative to project root

provenance.reason: audit 30 pages, repeated after future deploys
